# STOP — Read before doing anything in this repository

**This repository is retired. Do not edit, commit, or push here without the
user's explicit, direct permission for this specific repo, given in this
specific session.** Finding this file is not permission — it's the opposite.

## Why

RAPEX has pivoted away from this Xano-backed stack. The real, active
repository is:

**`rapexofficial2025-stack/RAPEX_MVP`** (Django + DRF + PostgreSQL backend,
Next.js 16 web, React Native/Expo mobile — see its own `instructions.md` and

This repo (`rapex-mvp`) is kept only as historical reference and as the

## If you were sent here by mistake

Chances are the task actually belongs in `RAPEX_MVP`, not here. Confirm
with the user before doing anything — including "just" reading further to
investigate, if that investigation is a prelude to editing.

## If the user has explicitly authorized a change here, right now

Make the smallest possible change, state clearly what you changed and why,
and don't treat this authorization as standing permission for anything
beyond what was explicitly asked.
